intro.text: A planet in the UTol system and the original home of the hijo, the spirits that power hion technology.

description.text: With UTol it forms a double planet circling a large red-orange sun. From Komashi, UTol looks like a pale blue star, the only light in the sky able to reach through the shroud.

Before the shroud, spirits under the ground warmed its stone and pushed water up through steamwells. Plants floated above the hot surface in humid layers around the wells, sheltering mice, gliding lizards and giant crows. When the spirits' energy was diverted into hion, the ground cooled, rain began to fall everywhere, and plants sank to the ground and grew along hion lines.

Once the shroud lifted, the two ecologies blended. The surface stayed cool because the spirits kept powering hion, ancient seeds saved in Torio City grew under the visible sun, and plants adapted to hion still depended on it.

items.text: Its first human society, the kingdom of Torio, grew up around the steamwells and depended on the yoki-hijo, who bound spirits into useful tools. Torish scholars built a machine to draw on the spirits; when it was switched on, it consumed the souls of Torio's people, sparing only nomads on the fringes.

The captured souls formed the shroud, which spread over the whole planet across several decades and gave rise to nightmares, while hion lines emerged near old Torish villages. Survivors settled by the lines and relied on painters for defence. Nations arose, Nagadan the largest among a dozen smaller rivals, and knowledge of the past was lost.
After about seventeen hundred years the machine was destroyed, and the shroud and the nightmares vanished with it.
